result.stderr:
Usage: acop-mcp [--base-uri <url>] [--bearer-token <token>] [--token-endpoint <url> --client-id <id> --client-secret <secret> [--audience <aud>]]
Required env / flags:
  ACOP_BACKEND_BASE_URI  HTTP base URI of the ACOP coordination middleware.
  ACOP_BACKEND_BEARER_TOKEN  (optional) bearer token for authenticated calls.
  ACOP_BACKEND_TOKEN_ENDPOINT / CLIENT_ID / CLIENT_SECRET  (optional) OIDC client_credentials token source.
  ACOP_BACKEND_AUDIENCE  (optional) token audience.
